title: BirthLotteryCard
description: v1 card: one composite life, today only. Never a named real person. Missing stays missing (null). Race/sexuality/disability only when a country-real source is attached in sources[].

card_id.description: Stable prototype id, e.g. proto-001. Not a person name.

country_iso3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3. For Kosovo use XKX if included; for Palestine PSE; for Taiwan TWN.

country_name.description: Short English name used on the card, not the UN formal title.

weight_in_country.description: This composite's share of the country's adult-or-all-age draw mass for the prototype (not the country draw p_mix). Prototype only; v1 engine will sample from distributions instead of storing this.

age_band.description: WPP 2024 age groups collapsed to these bands. Source: UN WPP 2024.

sex.description: WPP sex. Intersex/other stays unknown in v1; do not invent a third category without a country census code.

urban_rural.description: UN WUP. null if the country is missing from WUP.

income_or_consumption_ppp_band.description: World Bank PIP consumption or income per person per day, 2021 PPP. International poverty line is $3.00; LMIC $4.20; UMIC $8.30. High-income countries often not_in_pip; leave null rather than using GDP/capita as a person-level stand-in. Do not mix 2017 PPP $2.15 into the same field.

education.description: Person-level attainment band from Barro-Lee / UNESCO. null if the country-year is missing. Do not fill from HDI.

occupation_class.description: ILOSTAT ISCO or status-in-employment collapsed. null if missing. Not a job title.

family.description: Only fields with a country-real household survey. Omit the rest. No invented spouse/children counts.

housing_energy_water_internet.description: Access flags. Each flag independently null if that indicator is missing for the country.

health_disability.description: Disability or major condition ONLY with a country-real source (IHME GBD country estimate or a named survey). Otherwise null, not 'none'.

condition_family.description: Broad GBD family (e.g. musculoskeletal, sensory, mental) if sourced; never a named diagnosis of a real person.

religion.description: null unless Pew (or equivalent) license allows this use AND the country is in the table. Otherwise {affiliation: unknown}.

sexuality_or_gender_minority.description: unknown unless a country-real survey exists. Never a global percentage guess.

country_life_expectancy.description: Period life expectancy at birth, years. WPP 2024 or UNDP HDR. Country-level context, not this composite's remaining years.
